findings.reason: The current Statement and proof restrict flow identification to affine paths contained in U while retaining derivative and canonical identities on the algebraic composition domain.
Added coordinate-by-coordinate contour-radius invariance via the one-variable Cauchy formula; this also supports uniform convergence on compact subsets.
Added thm-reals-cauchy-complete and a coordinatewise completeness argument for the uniformly Cauchy Picard iterates.

Made scalar Cauchy and parameter-integral uses componentwise, supplied the dimension factors for the stated Lipschitz bound, and derived the vector flow equation by differentiating the parameter integral.
Added the closure and distance estimate proving D(r) is star-shaped when U is star-shaped.
Proved real-analytic continuation along radial segments and real preservation of local Picard flows and their continuations.
Applied the Cauchy coefficient estimate at each radius r<r_N and took the limit r increasing to r_N.
The current lemma remark already carries a separate one-step map-Lipschitz hypothesis and distinguishes it from exact-flow stability.
